subject: Medisys technical readout & KPI request — POC scope and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Rivera <anna@medisys.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Medisys technical readout & KPI request — POC scope and next steps

Anna — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can lock the kickoff: 

Call recap (30m):
- Use case: automated clinical note enrichment + entity extraction + succinct summarization for care ops.
- Target traffic: bursty qps (~250–500 req/s peak), median session length ~ 1.2k tokens.
- Data: de-identified sample of patient notes + typical user prompts (you said ~10k rows).

Proposed 2-week POC (sandbox + scale):
1) Success metrics (we're proposing measurable, operational KPIs):
   - Latency: p95 generation latency < 150 ms (single-turn, 1.2k token context)
   - Throughput: sustain 400 req/s for 5-minute sustained window during peak simulation
   - Cost: average inference cost <= $0.0009 / token (post-batching/quantization)
   - Quality: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your evaluation set; summarization MOS >= 4.2/5 (customer-blind evaluation)

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (onboarding): access, sample data ingestion, baseline run on our hosted sandbox.
   - Week 1 (baseline + quality): run 10k sample queries, produce labeled metrics for F1/MOS.
   - Week 2 (scale & tuning): three scale tests (smoke, 50% load, 100% peak), iterate on batching/quantization.
   - Readout: final results doc + open action items; decision gate for Dedicated or Hosted.

3) Ownership / asks:
   - We need your sample data (de-identified) and a representative traffic profile CSV.
   - Network: IP whitelist or service account for sandbox; SSO if you prefer.
   - Security: please share the contact for SOC2 questionnaire follow-up.

Attachments: Medisys_POC_Template.pdf (template for scope & success criteria), redwood_demo-config.yaml (example runtime config).

Next steps: can we schedule a 60-min kickoff next Tue (2026-09-01) — propose 10:00am ET / 7:00am PT? If that works, we’ll get Monica and Karthik assigned as leads.

Thanks — I’ll draft the mutual action plan once we confirm kickoff.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0126

From: Anna Rivera <anna@medisys.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Luke Chen <luke.chen@medisys.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Medisys technical readout & KPI request — POC scope and next steps

Thanks Sean — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Quality: for entity extraction we measure using a clinical F1 (slot-level) — our internal goal is F1 > 0.88. For summarization we’d like to include a small human-blind MOS panel (target >= 4.2). Can Redwood support the blind evaluation workflow?

2) Cost: can you provide a rough cost estimate for the 2-week run (hosted sandbox vs dedicated baseline)? We need the ballpark for procurement.

3) Security: please send the SOC2 questionnaire and any required evidence list. Our security contact is security@medisys.ai — loop them in for the questionnaire and network requirements.

4) Timing: 9/1 at 10am ET looks feasible — I’ll confirm after checking with Luke. We’ll share sample queries by Friday.

Attaching medisys_sample_queries.csv (will be a redacted export).

Best,
Anna Rivera
Head of ML Ops, Medisys
anna@medisys.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Rivera <anna@medisys.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medisys technical readout & KPI request — POC scope and next steps

Anna — perfect, thanks for the clarifications. Yes, Redwood can run a blind MOS panel; we do that typically with anonymized outputs and a simple Likert instrument.

Cost estimates (rough):
- Hosted sandbox (2-week): approx $6k–9k total depending on token volume and test length.
- Dedicated baseline (reserved for POC week): add-on setup + minimum capacity bump, ballpark $18k for short reservation (pricing team to confirm).

I’ve asked Monica to own the onboarding/runbook and Karthik will be our tuning lead for performance. Monica — can you confirm availability for the 9/1 kickoff and whether we’ll need a dedicated capacity quote ahead of the kickoff?

We have medisys_sample_queries.csv received OK (thanks). Two asks before kickoff:
- Provide an anonymized traffic profile CSV (timestamps + request sizes) — we’ll use it to construct the load curve.
- Confirm whether you want TLS + IP whitelist or a service-account-based connection for the sandbox.

I’ll draft a short mutual action plan and share the runbook template.

—
Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medisys technical readout & KPI request — POC scope and next steps

Anna / Sean — I can take point on operations and runbook delivery. Quick owner/checklist: 

- Monica Patel (owner): onboarding, environment provisioning, runbook execution, readout doc.
- Karthik Iyer (owner): performance tuning, batching/quantization recommendations, kernel/profile selection.
- Sean Gallagher (owner): mutual action plan, stakeholder comms, procurement coordination.

Pre-kick checklist (to confirm before 9/1):
- Sample data + traffic profile (Medisys) — required
- Sandbox access method (IP whitelist vs service account) — required
- Security contact on thread (security@medisys.ai) — required
- PO/procurement contact for initial estimate (Medisys) — requested

I’ve uploaded the initial runbook template here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cmedisys-poc (runbook-template.md attached).

Technical notes: we’ll likely start with a quantized variant for cost targets and iterate to a mixed precision path if quality regresses. If Medisys expects consistent p95 <150ms at 1.2k tokens, we’ll run a dedicated kernel-profile pass during Week 2.

My calendar is open for 9/1 10am ET — confirmed.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

For procurement, please send a short purchase order contact and an invoice-ready estimate to procurement@medisys.ai — I will route.

Also: please include in the kickoff agenda a 15-min section to review the blind MOS process and labeling instructions so our clinical reviewers are aligned.

Looking forward to the kickoff — see you Tuesday.

Anna
